meta.source: Pelletier et al. 2022 / Coltman et al. 2003, Ram Mountain bighorn sheep. Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.41d7q, CC0.
meta.note: A sheep with a dam but no sire is not an error: paternity was not assigned for every lamb. Stage B gives those the second copy from an unidentified ram, which is why about a fifth of the final cohort's copies trace to no founder in the file.
